soFar.title: Your answers so far
soFar.empty: Your answers will appear here as you go.

example.loaded: Example loaded. Pick when you plan to start, then build the roadmap — or change any answer.

sector.title: What will the business do?
sector.why: The sector decides which licences, environmental category and incentives apply.
sector.ideaPlaceholder: e.g. A cashew-processing plant exporting to India
sector.ideaHint: Tiva reads the sector from your idea; check it below.
sector.required: Choose the sector closest to your project.
sector.next: Next: where the project will be.

province.title: Where will the project be?
province.why: The province decides who approves some licences and which corridor and incentives apply.
province.unsureHint: Tiva will use Maputo City for now. You can change it later.
province.required: Choose a province, or “Not sure yet”.
province.next: Next: investment size, jobs and when you plan to start.

size.title: How much do you plan to invest?
size.why: Size decides who approves the project at APIEX and whether the foreign investment meets the minimum for the guarantees on repatriating profits.
size.exactHint: A range is enough for a first roadmap.
size.using: Tiva will use {{v}} as an estimate.
size.required: Choose a range or enter an amount of at least USD 1,000.
size.next: Next: where the investment comes from.

origin.title: Where does the investment come from?
origin.why: Your country decides whether a double taxation agreement lowers withholding tax, and foreign capital must be registered with Banco de Moçambique.
origin.countryHint: Countries marked ADT have a double taxation agreement with Mozambique.
origin.next: Next: how many people you will employ.

jobs.title: How many people will you employ?
jobs.why: Headcount sets your foreign-worker quota under Lei n.º 13/2023: within it a notification is enough; above it you need work permits.
jobs.hint: An estimate for the first year is fine.
jobs.required: Enter whole numbers; foreign workers cannot exceed the total.
jobs.next: Last: when you plan to start.

timing.title: When do you plan to start?
timing.why: Timing tells Tiva which steps to start now: the environmental licence and land can take months, so they often run in parallel.
timing.required: Choose when you plan to start.
timing.next: Then Tiva builds your nine-step roadmap.

facts.hint: Tick what applies. Each one adds a step or a check to your roadmap.
facts.needsLand: We need land (DUAT) for the project
facts.importsGoods: We will import equipment or goods
facts.shareholderLoan: A shareholder loan or foreign financing
facts.feesAbroad: We will pay services or royalties abroad
